summary: Mount Everett's summit fire tower was dismantled and flown off by helicopter in 2003; no tower remains, and the summit is reached by trail.

facts.design: 38-ft tower with 10x10-ft cab (1915); 1970 replacement 40 ft by register, possibly 60 ft per Willhite
facts.status_note: Dismantled and airlifted off the summit by helicopter in spring 2003; register says sold to a private landowner in the same town.
facts.agency: Massachusetts Bureau of Forest Fire Control

access.note: Summit reached on foot in Mount Everett State Reservation; Appalachian Trail runs over the top. No tower remains.

visit.trail_note: No lookout to climb. Willhite lists access as 'Trail over the top'.

events.note: Register and Willhite: 38-ft tower with 10x10-ft cab erected. Forest Lookouts gives 1918 for the first erected tower; disputed.
Forest Lookouts only: '1918: A fire tower erected.' Conflicts with 1915 in the register and Willhite.
New tower constructed to replace the earlier structure.
Daily observer Ezra Whitbeck on duty 12 to 14 hours a day during a fire emergency (April 1947 newspaper, quoted by Forest Lookouts).
Stone lookout building constructed near the fire tower by Ernest Shorti of Edgemont.
New tower about 100 ft north of the two earlier towers, where the Appalachian Trail crosses the summit. Register: 40 ft. Willhite: may have been 60 ft. A Facebook snippet (not read) says 1971.
Last year of staffing per register and Willhite.
Massachusetts DEM wanted telecommunications equipment on the tower; townspeople opposed it and the town won.
Registered August 28, 2002 as US 431, MA 2; nominated by Henry Isenberg.
Dismantled and airlifted off the summit by helicopter in spring 2003. Register gives disputes with town officials as reason.
Registered September 3, 2008 as US 49, MA 49 on the Former Fire Lookout Sites Register.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and Willhite say the first 38-ft tower was erected in 1915. Forest Lookouts lists a fire tower erected in 1918. The story uses 1915 and mentions the 1918 variant.
Register says 40 ft; Willhite says 40 ft and that it may have been 60 ft. No height_m is recorded because the tower is gone.

notes_for_editor: Removal in 2003 is well supported (register, Forest Lookouts, Willhite). Unresolved: first tower 1915 vs 1918; 1970 tower height 40 ft vs possibly 60 ft; 1970 vs 1971 completion (a Facebook search snippet from FFLA Massachusetts says 1971, not read). Staffing history is taken from the register and Willhite only; the 1947 observer is named in Willhite and in a 1947 newspaper quoted on Forest Lookouts. Leads not read: 2006 Mount Everett summit resource management plan on mass.gov (mentions a 2000 proposal to repair the tower). Access is public trail access; no tower to climb.
